evidence.quote: If the piece is not returned by that time, a standard $120 equipment replacement fee will be automatically charged to the corporate card on file.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題常見關鍵字改寫，如將「charged to the corporate card on file」轉述為「billed to a credit card」，解題時應對齊具體條件與結果。

content.title: Northfield Green Spaces Volunteer Recruitment
content.scenario_summary: An urban conservation group issues an advertisement announcing the postponement of an autumn tree-planting project due to a shipping delay of protective sapling guards, using the extended timeframe to recruit additional community volunteers.

blocks.text: Join the Northfield Green Spaces Volunteer Team!

The Northfield Urban Canopy Project invites local residents to take part in our autumn tree-planting campaign. Because of an unexpected shipping delay affecting our bulk order of protective sapling guards, the initial fieldwork originally scheduled for October 5 has been rescheduled to begin on Saturday, October 19.

This schedule adjustment allows us to welcome additional community members to the team. We are reopening registration for fifteen new fieldwork assistants. Volunteers will assist arborists with planting native oak and maple saplings in Elmwood Park and monitoring soil moisture levels. No previous horticultural experience is required; our staff will provide on-site guidance and all necessary hand tools.
To participate, complete the brief volunteer signup form at www.northfieldcanopy.example by October 12. Registered volunteers will receive an informational packet by email on October 14.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the advertisement?

options.label: A
options.text: To invite community members to join a rescheduled tree-planting project

options.label: B
options.text: To announce the opening of a newly renovated public park

options.label: C
options.text: To recruit professional arborists for a municipal landscaping agency

options.label: D
options.text: To solicit financial donations for protective gardening equipment

explanation.summary_zh: 該廣告旨在說明植樹活動延期，並趁此調整開放更多社區志工報名參與。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 通篇廣告開頭即邀請居民參與秋季植樹活動，並說明因護苗裝置運送延遲，初次實地作業順延至10月19日；接著指出此項調整讓機構得以重新開放15個志工名額（reopening registration for fifteen new fieldwork assistants）。因此核心目的為招募社區人士加入這項改期後的植樹專案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。內文結合了專案改期（rescheduled to begin on Saturday, October 19）與重新開放志工登記（invites local residents... reopening registration）的訊息。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文中僅提及活動地點在 Elmwood Park，並未提及該公園剛翻修完成或正在舉行重新開放儀式。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。志工的任務是協助樹藝師（assist arborists），而非招募專業樹藝師正職員工。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。防護用具（sapling guards）是因運送延誤而導致活動改期，廣告中並無向公眾募集資金或要求捐款的內容。

evidence.quote: The Northfield Urban Canopy Project invites local residents to take part in our autumn tree-planting campaign. Because of an unexpected shipping delay affecting our bulk order of protective sapling guards, the initial fieldwork originally scheduled for October 5 has been rescheduled to begin on Saturday, October 19.
We are reopening registration for fifteen new fieldwork assistants.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解答廣告主旨題時，需整合「活動事件」（植樹專案改期）與「溝通動作」（開放志工報名），避免只抓單一詞彙而誤選局部的背景細節。

questions.prompt: What caused the postponement of the initial fieldwork?

options.label: A
options.text: Inclement weather forecasts in Elmwood Park

options.label: B
options.text: A delayed shipment of protective supplies

options.label: C
options.text: An insufficient number of registered participants

options.label: D
options.text: Ongoing repairs to municipal gardening equipment

explanation.summary_zh: 活動延期是因為大批訂購的樹苗防護罩運送延遲。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 開頭段明確指出延期原因為「an unexpected shipping delay affecting our bulk order of protective sapling guards」，選項 (B) 的「A delayed shipment of protective supplies」是此句的精確同義改寫。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。公告全文完全未提及惡劣天氣預報。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。文中的 shipping delay 對應 delayed shipment，protective sapling guards 對應 protective supplies。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。增加志工名額是延期後產生的機會（allows us to welcome additional community members），而非導致延期的起因。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。工具是由主辦單位現場提供（provide on-site guidance and all necessary hand tools），文中未提及任何設備維修問題。

evidence.quote: Because of an unexpected shipping delay affecting our bulk order of protective sapling guards, the initial fieldwork originally scheduled for October 5 has been rescheduled to begin on Saturday, October 19.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 多益閱讀細節題常將因果關係中的名詞以概括字替代，如將 protective sapling guards 換為同義的 protective supplies，閱讀時應注意核心名詞與因果標記詞（Because of）。

content.title: Avenel Hotel & Suites Stay Customization
content.scenario_summary: A boutique hotel website outlines its pre-arrival room customization options for registered guests, including pillow selections, temperature settings, and housekeeping preferences, along with submission deadlines.

documents.title: Avenel Hotel & Suites - Pre-Arrival Room Preferences

blocks.text: Avenel Hotel & Suites: Personalizing Your Stay

At Avenel Hotel & Suites, we strive to ensure that every stay meets your personal standards of comfort. Registered guests can customize their accommodations prior to arrival by accessing the Guest Preferences portal through our website or mobile app.

Available options include selecting items from our complimentary pillow menu (such as memory foam or hypoallergenic down-alternative), setting an arrival room temperature, and indicating a preferred housekeeping window.

To give our housekeeping team adequate time to prepare your room, please finalize your selections at least 24 hours before your scheduled check-in. Requests received after this deadline will be accommodated based on on-site availability at the front desk.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the web page?

options.label: A
options.text: To advertise discounted room rates for loyalty club members

options.label: B
options.text: To explain how guests can tailor room settings before arriving

options.label: C
options.text: To outline safety protocols for hotel housekeeping staff

options.label: D
options.text: To describe checkout procedures for departing visitors

explanation.summary_zh: 本網頁主要旨在說明旅客如何在抵達前自訂各項客房偏好與設定。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 首段即點明已登記旅客可在入住前透過專屬入口網站自訂客房設定（customize their accommodations prior to arrival），隨後列舉枕頭種類、溫度與清掃時段等選項，並說明操作期限，故主要目的為向旅客介紹抵達前的客房個人化設定服務。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 內文並未提及會員折扣房價或促銷專案。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 符合全文主旨，詳細說明旅客如何於抵達飯店前依個人喜好調整客房設備與服務設定。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中提及房務團隊（housekeeping team）僅為說明客房準備作業，並非針對內部員工的安全作業規範。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 本頁面著眼於入住前的偏好選取（check-in 前），而非退房（checkout）程序。

evidence.quote: Registered guests can customize their accommodations prior to arrival by accessing the Guest Preferences portal through our website or mobile app.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主旨題應著重掌握網頁標題與開頭主題句，辨識核心溝通目標，避免受到文中僅為次要補充的字詞干擾。

questions.prompt: According to the web page, what are guests instructed to do to ensure their room requests are prepared?

options.label: A
options.text: Submit their selections at least 24 hours prior to check-in

options.label: B
options.text: Pay an additional service charge upon arrival

options.label: C
options.text: Collect specialized linens directly from the front desk

explanation.summary_zh: 旅客須於預定入住前至少 24 小時完成偏好選項的提交。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文章最後一段明確指出，為讓房務團隊有充裕時間準備房間，旅客請務必於預定入住時間前至少 24 小時完成選取（finalize your selections at least 24 hours before your scheduled check-in）。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確對應最後一段的規定（at least 24 hours before your scheduled check-in）。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 內文註明枕頭選單為免費提供（complimentary），未提及需支付額外服務費用。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中說明逾期提出的要求須視當時可提供或安排的情況而定，並未指示旅客須親自前往櫃檯領取寢具。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 網頁指引旅客透過官網或行動應用程式（website or mobile app）操作，未要求以電話聯繫管理部門。

evidence.quote: To give our housekeeping team adequate time to prepare your room, please finalize your selections at least 24 hours before your scheduled check-in.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解答本題時，可根據題幹的關鍵詞（如 ensure、prepared、instructed）定位文中的目的片語與時間規定，核對旅客應完成的動作及期限。

content.title: Museum Visitor Services Chat
content.scenario_summary: A museum visitor initiates a live chat with visitor services before an upcoming exhibition visit to request switching from a docent-guided group tour to a self-paced audio guide format to accommodate a companion's mobility preference, which the representative arranges free of charge.

blocks.text: Museum Visitor Services — Live Chat

Hello, I booked two tickets for tomorrow's 'Luminous Artifacts' exhibition (Order #LA-5104). The confirmation lists us for the 2:00 P.M. docent-led gallery tour, but we would actually prefer to explore the displays at our own pace using the handheld audio guides.
blocks.speaker: Derek Choi

blocks.text: Good morning, Mr. Choi! I can easily update that for you. Switching your booking to self-guided admission with interactive audio devices carries no additional fee.
blocks.speaker: Nora Gable

blocks.text: That works much better for us. My companion has limited mobility and prefers not having to keep up with a walking group.
blocks.speaker: Derek Choi

blocks.text: Understood. I have switched both passes to self-guided entry and reserved two audio wands under your name. When you arrive tomorrow, simply show your digital barcode at the multimedia kiosk beside Gallery 2.
blocks.speaker: Nora Gable

blocks.text: Thank you so much for your help!
blocks.speaker: Derek Choi

questions.prompt: Why did Mr. Choi initiate the chat?

options.label: A
options.text: To change the format of his upcoming exhibition visit

options.label: B
options.text: To inquire about admission fees for special exhibits

options.label: C
options.text: To request wheelchair rental at the museum lobby

options.label: D
options.text: To reschedule his booking to a different date

explanation.summary_zh: 崔先生發起對話的主要目的是更改參觀特展的形式，從原本的專人隨行導覽換成使用語音導覽設備的自由參觀。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在對話一開始，崔先生說明他的預約確認信上被排定參加下午兩點的「專人隨行導覽（docent-led gallery tour）」，但他與同伴希望能改為以自己的步調使用手持語音導覽參觀（explore the displays at our own pace using the handheld audio guides）。這屬於參觀形式（format）的調整，因此 (A) 是正確答案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。崔先生提出希望將專人導覽團改為自導式語音導覽，即更改參觀展覽的形式（format）。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。雖然客服後續提到更換不加價（carries no additional fee），但崔先生發起對話並非為了詢問特展票價。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。崔先生雖在後續訊息提及同行者行動較不便（limited mobility），但這是用來解釋為何不想跟團走動，他並未要求租借輪椅。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。崔先生依然維持原定的明天（tomorrow）參觀，並未要求改期至其他日期。

evidence.quote: The confirmation lists us for the 2:00 P.M. docent-led gallery tour, but we would actually prefer to explore the displays at our own pace using the handheld audio guides.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主旨題應鎖定發起者在對話開頭明確陳述的需求核心，並注意區分「主要訴求」與後文提出的「補充背景原因」。

questions.prompt: At 10:17 A.M., what does Mr. Choi most likely mean when he writes, "That works much better for us"?

options.label: A
options.text: He wants to postpone his museum reservation.

options.label: B
options.text: He welcomes the option to switch to self-guided audio tours.

options.label: C
options.text: He is requesting a discount on his admission tickets.

options.label: D
options.text: He needs help navigating the museum's mobile app.

questions.target_text: That works much better for us.

explanation.summary_zh: 崔先生說「那對我們來說好多了」，表示他樂於接受並贊同客服專員提出可免費切換為語音自導參觀的方案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在前一則訊息中，客服人員專員諾拉（Nora）表示可以輕鬆為他更改預約，且改為自導式語音導覽無須額外費用。崔先生緊接著回覆「That works much better for us」，並說明同行者行動不便、不適合跟著團體移動。因此這句話是表示對更換為自導語音方案感到滿意與歡迎，對應 (B)。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。崔先生沒有延後預約參觀日期的意思。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。崔先生針對專員提出的自導語音更換選項表示滿意並樂於接受。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。雖然客服提及更換免費，但崔先生並非在要求門票折扣。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。對話提及的是現場領取手持語音設備（audio guides / wands），完全未談及手機應用程式或操作求助。

evidence.quote: Switching your booking to self-guided admission with interactive audio devices carries no additional fee.
That works much better for us. My companion has limited mobility and prefers not having to keep up with a walking group.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 言外之意題（Intent）應檢視上一句對方的陳述或提議，理解該口語表達所傳達的態度（贊成、滿意、婉拒等）。

content.title: SparkPoint Commons Member Support
content.scenario_summary: A coworking space member contacts the community manager via instant chat seeking alternative workspace for an expanded team. Because temporary safety rules cap the mezzanine lounge capacity during stairwell painting, the manager offers an available studio room that fits the group at no extra cost.

blocks.text: Hi Leo. Three remote colleagues from our Portland branch arrived unexpectedly this morning to join four of us for a design sprint. Can we move our seven-person group over to the mezzanine lounge?
blocks.speaker: Rhea Talbott

blocks.text: Good morning, Rhea. Under our temporary safety rules while the south stairwell is repainted, occupancy on the mezzanine is strictly capped at ten people. There are already eight members working up there right now.
blocks.speaker: Leo Vance

blocks.text: Ah, that won't work then, as there are only two open spots and we need to sit together.
blocks.speaker: Rhea Talbott

blocks.text: Understood. However, Focus Studio B on the second floor is unreserved until 1:00 PM today. It accommodates up to eight people, includes a digital whiteboard, and is covered by your current plan at no extra charge.
blocks.speaker: Leo Vance

blocks.text: That will do nicely.
blocks.speaker: Rhea Talbott

blocks.text: Great! I just placed a hold on Focus Studio B for Kestrel Media through 1:00 PM. You can tap your regular keycards to unlock the door whenever you are ready.
blocks.speaker: Leo Vance

blocks.text: Thanks for sorting this out so quickly, Leo. We are heading upstairs now.
blocks.speaker: Rhea Talbott

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Talbott contact Mr. Vance?

options.label: A
options.text: To request a suitable workspace for her team

options.label: B
options.text: To report an issue with electronic keycards

options.label: C
options.text: To upgrade her company's membership tier

options.label: D
options.text: To ask about maintenance on a staircase

explanation.summary_zh: Ms. Talbott 聯絡 Mr. Vance 是為了替團隊尋找合適的額外工作空間。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Ms. Talbott 在第一則訊息中說明有三位外地同仁前來，加上原有的四位成員共七人要進行專案衝刺，因此詢問能否將整組移至夾層休息區。此舉旨在為團隊尋找能容納全員共同協作的場地，故 (A) 正確。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Ms. Talbott 說明因臨時有額外成員加入，需要能容納七人的工作空間，因此主動洽詢可用場地。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。感應卡（keycards）是 Mr. Vance 後續說明如何進入 Studio B 時提到的，並非 Ms. Talbott 主動回報的故障問題。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。Mr. Vance 後續提到 Focus Studio B 已包含在現有方案中（covered by your current plan），Ms. Talbott 並未要求升級會員等級。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。樓梯間油漆維護是 Mr. Vance 解釋夾層人數受限的原因，並非 Ms. Talbott 最初詢問的事項。

evidence.quote: Hi Leo. Three remote colleagues from our Portland branch arrived unexpectedly this morning to join four of us for a design sprint. Can we move our seven-person group over to the mezzanine lounge?

explanation.takeaway_zh: 商務對話的目的題（purpose）通常出現在發起者的首則訊息中，注意辨識表達請求（Can we...?）或陳述需求的核心句子。

questions.prompt: Why is capacity in the mezzanine lounge currently restricted?

options.label: A
options.text: New office furniture is being delivered.

options.label: B
options.text: Painting work is being done on a stairwell.

options.label: C
options.text: A digital whiteboard is undergoing repairs.

options.label: D
options.text: A private workshop has reserved the space.

explanation.summary_zh: 夾層休息區人數受限是因為南側樓梯間正在進行油漆作業。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Mr. Vance 在 9:16 AM 的回覆中說明：「Under our temporary safety rules while the south stairwell is repainted, occupancy on the mezzanine is strictly capped at ten people.」，明確指出上限十人是因為南側樓梯間正在重新粉刷，對應選項 (B)。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。對話中完全未提及家具運送或更換。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。文中「while the south stairwell is repainted」精準對應選項中的「Painting work is being done on a stairwell」。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。數位白板是 Focus Studio B 的現有設備，並無故障或維修的情形。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。夾層內已有八名會員在工作，但並非被私人工作坊包場或預約。

evidence.quote: Under our temporary safety rules while the south stairwell is repainted, occupancy on the mezzanine is strictly capped at ten people.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題常用不同句型轉述同一事件。本題 is repainted 與 painting work is being done 都使用被動語態；後者以 painting work 作主詞，是一個子句。核對兩句是否都描述樓梯間的油漆作業即可。

questions.prompt: At 9:21 A.M., what does Ms. Talbott most likely mean when she writes, "That will do nicely"?

options.label: A
options.text: She accepts the proposed alternative room.

options.label: B
options.text: She is willing to pay an additional fee.

options.label: C
options.text: She would like to extend a booking until late afternoon.

options.label: D
options.text: She agrees that the lounge has sufficient seating.

explanation.summary_zh: Ms. Talbott 寫下「That will do nicely」代表她接受 Mr. Vance 所提議的替代房間方案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在 9:20 AM，Mr. Vance 提議改用二樓的 Focus Studio B，說明該空間可容納八人、配有白板、當天可使用至下午 1:00，且已包含在現有方案內，不另收費。Ms. Talbott 隨即回覆「That will do nicely.」（那樣就很合適／那樣很好），表示接受這項替代方案，隨後對方也替其保留了該房間，故 (A) 符合語意。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。在 Mr. Vance 提供 Focus Studio B 作為替代方案後，Ms. Talbott 用此句表示該房間非常合適並接受提議。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。Mr. Vance 已註明該工作室包含在現有方案內且不另收費（at no extra charge），故不涉及付費意願。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。該空間僅空閒至下午 1:00，Ms. Talbott 並未提出要延長預約至傍晚。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。Ms. Talbott 在前面已經確認夾層只剩兩個空位，不足以容納七人（that won't work），並未認為休息區座位充足。

evidence.quote: Understood. However, Focus Studio B on the second floor is unreserved until 1:00 PM today. It accommodates up to eight people, includes a digital whiteboard, and is covered by your current plan at no extra charge.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 言外之意題（intent）需結合前文提議判斷。「That will do (nicely)」是實用商務慣用語，意為「那樣就很行／那樣很合適」，通常用來表示滿意並接受對方提出的替代解決方案。

content.title: Award Eligibility Verification Letter
content.scenario_summary: The Tri-County Business Council writes to an operations director at Solstice Courier Services regarding their Green Freight Excellence Award nomination, clarifying an unverified three-year licensing eligibility condition and requesting a 2022 operating certificate before the judging panel convenes.

blocks.text:
TRI-COUNTY BUSINESS COUNCIL
Awards Review Committee
100 Riverfront Plaza, Suite 400
Capital City, CA 95814

Date: August 14
To: Julian Ross, Operations Director, Solstice Courier Services
From: Vivian Chen, Chair, Green Freight Awards Committee
Subject: Nomination for Green Freight Excellence Award

Dear Mr. Ross,

Thank you for submitting Solstice Courier Services as a candidate for the annual Green Freight Excellence Award. The selection committee has completed an initial review of your entry portfolio, which included your vehicle emissions audit, client recommendation letters, and the executive summary of your route-optimization software.

While your submission highlights notable achievements in lowering transit emissions, we must clarify an essential eligibility condition before your file can proceed. Under Section 4B of the official awards criteria, all competing enterprises must possess an active commercial carrier license within the county for at least three consecutive years. Although your application includes your current operating permit, it lacks documented evidence of licensure for the 2022 calendar year.

To satisfy this condition, please upload a certified copy of your 2022 county carrier certificate to the review portal by August 25. Nominees who fulfill this requirement will advance to the final evaluation panel in September. Please note that no supplementary processing fees apply to these verification records.

Sincerely,
Vivian Chen
Chair, Green Freight Awards Committee

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the letter?

options.label: A
options.text: To notify an applicant about an unverified eligibility requirement

options.label: B
options.text: To announce the recipients of an environmental award

options.label: C
options.text: To invite an executive to join an awards evaluation committee

options.label: D
options.text: To request payment for an overdue entry processing fee

explanation.summary_zh: 信件的主要目的是通知申請人尚有一項參賽資格條件未被核實，並要求補交證明文件。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 信件第二段指出委員會審查初步資料後，發現參賽規則第4B條規定企業必須具備連續三年的營運許可，但該公司的申請資料中缺少2022年的證明；第三段接著請對方於8月25日前補件以完成資格確認。因此主要目的是通知未完成驗證的資格條件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。信件明確告知 Ross 先生其申請資料缺少2022年的營運證明，要求補件以符合參選資格。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不正確。信件提及評審團決選將於九月舉行，目前僅處於資格初審階段，並非公布獲獎名單。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不正確。Ross 先生是參賽候選企業的代表，而非被邀請擔任評審委員。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不正確。信末特別註明補充驗證文件不收取任何額外處理費用（no supplementary processing fees apply），並無催繳報名費之事。

evidence.quote: While your submission highlights notable achievements in lowering transit emissions, we must clarify an essential eligibility condition before your file can proceed.
To satisfy this condition, please upload a certified copy of your 2022 county carrier certificate to the review portal by August 25.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 信件的主旨題常由信件中段的轉折句（如 While... / However... we must clarify...）與隨後的行動請求（please upload...）共同構成。

questions.prompt: What is NOT mentioned as an item included in Solstice Courier Services' initial entry portfolio?

explanation.summary_zh: 駕駛安全培訓紀錄未在信件中提及，因此為正確答案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 信件第一段列舉了評審委員會已收到的初步申請組合內容，包括：車輛排放審計（vehicle emissions audit）、客戶推薦信（client recommendation letters）及路徑最佳化軟體的執行摘要（executive summary of your route-optimization software）。駕駛安全培訓紀錄（driver safety training log）完全未被提及。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不選。第一段已明確提及包含「client recommendation letters」（客戶推薦信）。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不選。第一段已明確提及包含「vehicle emissions audit」（車輛排放審計報告）。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。全文皆未提及「driver safety training log」（駕駛安全培訓紀錄），符合題目所問之「NOT mentioned」。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不選。第一段已明確提及包含「the executive summary of your route-optimization software」（路徑最佳化軟體的執行摘要）。

evidence.quote: The selection committee has completed an initial review of your entry portfolio, which included your vehicle emissions audit, client recommendation letters, and the executive summary of your route-optimization software.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解答否定細節題（NOT mentioned）時，應快速定位文章中列舉清單處（如本篇第一段後句），逐一核對選項並排除文中已列出的項目。

questions.prompt: In the letter, the word "advance" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: 在此處上下文環境中，"advance" 的意思為進入下一階段（前進／晉級），與 "proceed" 意思最為接近。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文中句子為「Nominees who fulfill this requirement will advance to the final evaluation panel in September.」（符合此要求的被提名者將晉級至九月份的最終評審階段）。advance 在此是不及物動詞，表示在選拔程序中「前進、晉級至下一關」，與 proceed（繼續進行、前往下一階段）語意完全相符。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。"proceed" 作為不及物動詞，意為「前進、進入下一階段」，代入文意符合「晉級至評審團階段」。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不正確。"advertise" 意為「登廣告、宣傳」，與評選晉級無關。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不正確。"lend" 意為「出借、借貸」（源於 advance 作為預付款或借款的名詞／及物動詞義），在此處不合語境與句構。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 不正確。"develop" 意為「發展、研發」，雖然 advance 可表示技能或科技進步，但在「advance to the panel」（晉級至評審階段）的移動／流程關卡語境中並不恰當。

evidence.quote: Nominees who fulfill this requirement will advance to the final evaluation panel in September.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 字彙題需依據上下文中的搭配介系詞及句子架構（如 advance to + 下一階段／地點）判斷動詞多義字在該場景的特定含義。

content.title: Vanguard Recycling Solutions Container Replacement Schedule
content.scenario_summary: An environmental services provider issues a daily field schedule detailing route assignments for technicians swapping out damaged commercial recycling containers and bins across regional client facilities.

blocks.text: Vanguard Recycling Solutions
Commercial Bin Replacement Schedule – Western District

Technicians must inspect all retrieved commercial recycling receptacles for serial number plates before loading them onto flatbed trucks. If a customer's damaged container holds unseparated refuse, notify the facility liaison before proceeding with the exchange. All replaced units are to be transported to the railside sorting yard by 16:30 for refurbishment.
Scheduled Receptacle Exchanges for November 14
rows: Position replacement near the hydraulic lift; secure latch pin.
Exchange interior canvas liners; verify electronic lock codes.
Fit new watertight rubber gasket; collect signed transfer receipt.
Provide replacement hazardous-materials placard to shipping desk.

blocks.text: Important: Technicians encountering blocked loading bays must phone dispatch immediately rather than skipping an assigned stop. In accordance with municipal guidelines, exchange manifests must be uploaded to the central portal prior to logging out for the day.

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of the schedule?

options.label: A
options.text: To coordinate the exchange of commercial recycling containers

options.label: B
options.text: To notify municipal authorities about hazardous material handling

options.label: C
options.text: To bill corporate clients for emergency receptacle repairs

options.label: D
options.text: To evaluate the daily route performance of new truck drivers

explanation.summary_zh: 此行程表的主要目的是統籌各商業客戶回收容器的更換作業。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文件標題明確標註為「商業回收桶更換排程」（Commercial Bin Replacement Schedule），表格中按時段列出各客戶、更換項目（如紙板壓縮箱、機密文件碎紙機櫃、有機廢棄物料斗等）、負責司機及具體作業指示。因此，主要目的在於協調與執行容器更換任務。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。文件核心即為規劃與分配外勤人員前往各商業機構更換回收容器（exchange of commercial recycling containers）的各項行程。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。表格中僅有一處指示提及交付危險物品標示牌，並非整份文件向市政主管機關發送的通報。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。此為內部外勤派工排程，不含向客戶請款或收取緊急維修費用的帳單資訊。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文件中雖然指派了司機，但目的是交代清運路線與工作指示，而非評估新進人員的工作表現。

evidence.quote: Commercial Bin Replacement Schedule – Western District

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解答排程表（schedule）主旨題時，應綜合主副標題與表格核心欄位（如 Replacement Item、Special Instructions），從整體任務本質出發，避免受單一列的局部細節干擾。

questions.prompt: What is driver R. Kowalski instructed to do at Bayside Culinary Institute?

options.label: A
options.text: Secure a hydraulic lift latch pin

explanation.summary_zh: 司機 R. Kowalski 在 Bayside Culinary Institute 的指示是安裝水密橡膠墊圈。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 依據表格第三列，地點為 Bayside Culinary Institute，指派司機為 R. Kowalski，其特殊指示欄位明確註明「Fit new watertight rubber gasket; collect signed transfer receipt.」（安裝新的水密橡膠墊圈；取得簽署的移交收據）。fit 意同 install，故 (C) 為正確答案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。A 混用了 Apex Distribution Center 那一列的 hydraulic lift 與 secure latch pin。原文未說明插銷屬於油壓升降機；Bayside Culinary Institute 那一列要求安裝 gasket。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。確認電子鎖密碼（verify electronic lock codes）是司機 S. Chen 在第二站 Linden Corporate Plaza 的任務。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。表格明確指示需替換安裝水密橡膠墊圈（Fit new watertight rubber gasket）。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。交付危險物品標示牌（Provide replacement hazardous-materials placard）是司機 M. Garza 在第四站 Highland Microelectronics 的任務。

evidence.quote: Fit new watertight rubber gasket; collect signed transfer receipt.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 面對表格細節題，先以題幹中的專有名詞（人名與地點）進行雙重交叉比對定位至特定列，其他選項通常直接取材自同表中其他列的真實工作項目。

questions.prompt: In paragraph 1, the word "holds" is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: 在此處 holds 意為容器內部「裝有、容納」，與 contains 最為接近。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在第一段中，「If a customer's damaged container holds unseparated refuse...」，主詞為 container（容器），受詞為 refuse（廢棄物），holds 在此處表達容器裝有或容納某物，因此 contains（容納、裝有）為最佳同義詞。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。supports 意為「支撐、承受重量」，雖然 hold 可表示支撐（hold the weight），但此處上下文指容器內部裝有廢棄物，而非承受重力結構。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。contains 意為「容納、裝有」，代入原句語意完全吻合。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。reserves 意為「預留、保留」（如 reserve a room / hold a seat），與容器裝載實體廢棄物不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。conducts 意為「舉辦、執行」（如 hold a meeting / conduct an interview），不能用於容器裝物。

evidence.quote: If a customer's damaged container holds unseparated refuse, notify the facility liaison before proceeding with the exchange.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 字彙題需根據主詞與受詞的搭配關係判斷多義字之語境義。動詞 hold 具有「容納」（contain）、「支撐」（support）、「預定」（reserve）與「舉辦」（conduct）等多重意義；當描述容器與其內部物品時，其意思即為「容納、裝有」（contain）。

content.title: Kallio Market Research Study Recruitment Notice
content.scenario_summary: A market research company advertises for consumer research participants to test an unreleased banking app, reopening applications and adding participant slots due to a two-week postponement caused by partner server configuration delays.

documents.title: Participant Recruitment: Mobile Banking User Research Study

blocks.text: Participant Recruitment: Mobile Banking User Research Study

Kallio Market Research is seeking smartphone users to evaluate an unreleased personal finance application developed by a partner financial institution. [[1]] Selected participants will complete three remote usability exercises between November 17 and November 22, followed by a 45-minute virtual video interview with our design team. Every participant who completes both components will receive a $120 digital gift card sent by email within five business days of their interview.

The evaluation phase was originally scheduled to begin on November 3. [[2]] However, an unexpected delay in our partner firm's server configuration prompted us to postpone the project start date by two weeks. Because of this postponement, we have reopened our candidate pool and are accepting applications for 25 additional participant spots.

To qualify, applicants must be at least 21 years old, maintain an active personal checking account, and log into a mobile banking app on their smartphone at least three times weekly. Candidates must also have access to a desktop or laptop computer equipped with a functional webcam and microphone. [[3]] Prior participation in consumer research panels is not required. [[4]] Interested individuals should submit our brief screening questionnaire at www.kallioresearch.example/banking-study before November 10 at 5:00 P.M.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?

options.label: A
options.text: To announce the launch of a new mobile banking platform

options.label: B
options.text: To recruit participants for a consumer research study

options.label: C
options.text: To advertise job openings for research moderators

options.label: D
options.text: To notify banking clients about scheduled server downtime

explanation.summary_zh: 此廣告旨在徵求一般消費者參與尚未發布之行動網銀 App 的使用者研究測試。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文章開頭即指明「Kallio Market Research is seeking smartphone users to evaluate an unreleased personal finance application...」，且全文詳述研究任務、時程、酬勞與申請條件，核心目的在於招募受試者（recruit participants for a consumer research study）。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中提及該金融 App 尚未正式發布（unreleased），此廣告是為了測試該軟體，而非宣布產品正式上市發布。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 符合全文主旨，文中明確尋找智慧型手機用戶參與付費易用性測試與訪談。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 廣告徵求的是測試者／受試者（participants），而非招募研究主持人或訪談人員（moderators）。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 伺服器設定延誤是研究計畫延後兩週的原因，並非向銀行現有客戶發布系統維護停機公告。

evidence.quote: Kallio Market Research is seeking smartphone users to evaluate an unreleased personal finance application developed by a partner financial institution.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 閱讀徵才或研究招募廣告時，首段通常直接點出招募對象（如 seeking users to evaluate...）與專案目的，可快速鎖定主旨題答案。

questions.prompt: According to the advertisement, why was the study postponed?

options.label: A
options.text: Additional time was needed to set up servers.

options.label: B
options.text: Not enough qualified applicants submitted questionnaires.

options.label: C
options.text: Researchers decided to add more interview questions.

options.label: D
options.text: The screening deadline had to be extended for holiday travel.

explanation.summary_zh: 合作金融機構在伺服器設定上發生不可預期的延宕，因此需要額外時間進行伺服器設定。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第二段明確說明：「an unexpected delay in our partner firm's server configuration prompted us to postpone the project start date by two weeks」，對應選項 A 的「Additional time was needed to set up servers」。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確，文中提及「delay in our partner firm's server configuration」即指伺服器設定出現延誤，需要更多時間處理。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中提及因時程延後而「reopened our candidate pool and are accepting applications for 25 additional participant spots」，釋出額外名額是延後造成的結果，而非延後的原因。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中完全未提及研究人員決定增加訪談問題。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中未提及任何假期旅行（holiday travel）或因假期待延長截止日的資訊。

evidence.quote: However, an unexpected delay in our partner firm's server configuration prompted us to postpone the project start date by two weeks.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 因果細節題需精準區分「原因（cause）」與「結果（effect）」，避免將事件延期後採取的因應措施（如追加招募名額）誤當成延期的成因。

questions.prompt:
Where would this sentence fit most naturally in the passage?

"This hardware is necessary because our moderators must record participant reactions alongside shared screen views."
questions.target_text: This hardware is necessary because our moderators must record participant reactions alongside shared screen views.

explanation.summary_zh: 待插入句中的「This hardware」指代前一句所述的「具備視訊鏡頭與麥克風的桌上型或筆記型電腦」，置於 [3] 語意最為連貫。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 待插入句子開頭以指稱詞「This hardware」指稱特定硬體設備，並說明研究人員需同時記錄受試者表情與螢幕畫面。檢視第三段，[3] 前一句為「Candidates must also have access to a desktop or laptop computer equipped with a functional webcam and microphone」，正好提供了「hardware」的具體先行詞，且其後接續說明為何此硬體是必需的，銜接完全吻合。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 若置於 [1]，前文僅提到尋找智慧型手機使用者評估 App，尚未提及任何特定電腦硬體配備，無法提供「This hardware」之指涉對象。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 若置於 [2]，前後文皆為專案原定開始日期與伺服器延遲的時程討論，與錄影硬體需求毫無關聯。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確，緊接在桌機/筆電、鏡頭與麥克風的設備要求之後，完美解釋為何需要這些硬體配備。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 若置於 [4]，前文為「Prior participation in consumer research panels is not required」，後文為線上申請表連結，插入此句會打斷資格條件到申請步驟的語意過渡。

evidence.quote: Candidates must also have access to a desktop or laptop computer equipped with a functional webcam and microphone. [[3]] Prior participation in consumer research panels is not required.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 句子插入題需優先尋找代名詞與指稱詞（如 This hardware、These steps）在前文中的具體實體，並確認因果說明是否緊鄰其所支撐的規範條款。

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the research study?

options.label: A
options.text: Application intake had closed prior to the schedule adjustment.

options.label: B
options.text: Participants must hold an account specifically with the partner bank.

options.label: C
options.text: All evaluation sessions will be conducted in person.

options.label: D
options.text: Participants must have prior experience testing financial software.

explanation.summary_zh: 由文中「reopened our candidate pool」可合理推斷，在時程調整前該研究的受試者報名管道曾一度截止受理。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文中說明因為延期而重新開放候選人申請，並增加 25 個名額。reopened 表示申請管道在重新開放前曾關閉；結合延期後重新招募的語境，可合理推知原先的報名已結束，因此 A 最符合文意。這是依上下文作出的推論，並非文中明列每個事件的確切時間。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。reopened 表示先前曾關閉；結合因延期而重新接受申請的說明，可合理推論原先報名曾截止。

option_analysis.label: B

content.title: Commercial Photography System Trial
content.scenario_summary: Talon Kitchenware evaluates an automated commercial photography suite developed by Apex Imagery Labs during a two-month trial. After initial glare challenges with high-gloss enamel are fixed via lighting adjustments, Talon decides to adopt the system for standard e-commerce catalog items while keeping human freelance photographers for lifestyle campaigns.

documents.title: Talon Kitchenware Concludes Two-Month Studio Automation Trial

blocks.text: Talon Kitchenware Concludes Two-Month Studio Automation Trial

Regional housewares manufacturer Talon Kitchenware has officially concluded a two-month trial of an automated commercial photography system developed by Apex Imagery Labs. The pilot program aimed to evaluate whether mechanized camera rigs and standardized lighting presets could streamline the production of Talon's e-commerce catalog without compromising visual detail. During the eight-week evaluation, the system processed digital images for more than 400 cookware items. [[1]]

According to Talon's creative director, Maya Vance, the trial demonstrated clear efficiency gains in catalog workflow. Average turnaround times for basic product listings decreased from three business days to under six hours per SKU. Furthermore, Apex's cloud software automatically corrected background shadows and calibrated color profiles for polished stainless steel surfaces. [[2]] However, Talon noted minor challenges when capturing high-gloss enamel finishes, which initially required on-site stylists to reposition physical diffusion panels manually between shots. [[3]]

In response to this feedback, Apex modified its automated lighting sequences midway through the trial, effectively resolving the glare issues on reflective surfaces. [[4]] Pleased with the final results, Talon announced yesterday that it will adopt Apex’s system for all future standard website inventory. However, the company confirmed that live-model lifestyle photography for seasonal marketing campaigns will continue to be handled by independent commercial photographers.

[[4]] Pleased with the final results, Talon announced yesterday that it will adopt Apex’s system for all future standard website inventory.

content.title: Caledon Express Ticket Delivery Guidance
content.scenario_summary: A passenger support webpage on Caledon Express outlines troubleshooting procedures for missing digital ticket attachments, explaining bank fraud checks, corporate email firewall filtering, self-service portal retrieval, and station desk reprint rules.

documents.title: Caledon Express Passenger Support: Missing Ticket Attachments

blocks.text: Caledon Express Support Portal: Ticketing FAQ
Troubleshooting Missing PDF Ticket Attachments

When booking travel through Caledon Express, customers normally receive an automated confirmation email containing a digital boarding pass and a downloadable PDF ticket attachment within fifteen minutes of purchase. If you received the initial transaction summary but the ticket attachment is missing, your payment may still be under standard fraud-prevention review by your financial institution. In most cases, the secure attachment is automatically generated and delivered as soon as clearance is granted.

Before contacting passenger support, please check your email spam or junk folder, as corporate network firewalls frequently reroute messages with encrypted attachments. Alternatively, travelers can retrieve their travel documents instantly by logging into the 'Manage My Journey' portal on caledonrail.example using their six-character booking reference and the billing email address. From there, you can select 'Resend Documents' or export the pass directly to your smartphone wallet.

Please note that train conductors and platform gate scanners cannot accept credit card bank statements, purchase order receipts, or reservation numbers alone as valid travel credentials. Passengers must present the actual barcode on the PDF ticket or the mobile app wallet pass before boarding. If departure is within ninety minutes and your attachment remains unavailable online, visit any Caledon station customer service desk, where an agent will print your boarding credential upon presentation of official government-issued photo identification.

content.title: Vanguard Athletics Morning Pilot Program
content.scenario_summary: Following a successful four-week pilot program testing early morning fitness and recovery classes at Vanguard Athletics, management issues an internal memorandum announcing the permanent schedule, room adjustments to relieve studio crowding, and instructor reassignments.

blocks.text: Vanguard Athletics — Downtown Facility
Four-Week Pilot Program: Early Morning Conditioning & Recovery (October 2–27)
Pilot Class Schedule

Program Guidelines: Studio B sessions are capped at 12 participants during the trial period to monitor equipment spacing with stability rollers and resistance bands. Attendees must submit session evaluation forms to the instructor immediately following each workout.
MEMORANDUM
To: Downtown Facility Staff
From: Nadine Boyer, Regional Program Director
Date: October 30
Subject: Winter Adoption of Morning Pilot Classes

Thank you for your dedication during our monthlong morning fitness pilot. With average attendance exceeding 90 percent capacity and participant satisfaction at 95 percent, management has officially approved integrating these early sessions into our permanent winter timetable starting Monday, November 6.

Member feedback highlighted strong enthusiasm for our 30-minute classes, but several participants reported crowding around the perimeter storage bins in Studio B. To resolve this issue, Alyssa Thorne's classes will move to Studio A, which can comfortably accommodate up to 25 members. Maintenance staff will transfer additional equipment into Studio A before Friday evening to support the larger group size.

Additionally, staffing adjustments will take effect next week. Kenji Sato will take over the Friday morning recovery session, enabling Devon Reed to lead our new evening personal training consultations. Registration for all morning classes will open on the Vanguard mobile app this Thursday at 8:00 A.M.

content.title: Supplemental Air Scrubber Allocation Policy, Tenant Intake Form, and Maintenance Follow-Up Email
content.scenario_summary: During a property-wide corridor ceiling and flooring restoration project at Crestline Plaza, the building management publishes a resource allocation policy for portable commercial HEPA air scrubbers. An optical laboratory tenant submits an equipment request and pre-service feedback form requesting three units, requiring an extra refundable deposit. The maintenance supervisor subsequently sends an email regarding a unit replacement and confirms that restoration in Building West finished before the planned property-wide completion date.

blocks.text: Crestline Plaza: Supplemental Air Scrubber Allocation Policy

To control airborne dust and fine particulates during our property-wide corridor ceiling and flooring restoration (October 6–October 24), Crestline Facilities will deploy commercial HEPA air scrubbers to tenant spaces upon request.

Standard allocations include up to two portable scrubbers per leased suite at no cost. Tenants operating sensitive facilities or high-density work areas may request up to two supplemental scrubbers (maximum four units per suite). Each supplemental scrubber requires a refundable security deposit of $140, which will be credited back following equipment retrieval in good working condition.

Allocation priority is structured into three tiers: Priority 1 covers certified diagnostic and optical laboratories; Priority 2 covers suites with more than 30 regular on-site staff; and Priority 3 covers general commercial and administrative offices.
Operational Requirements: Participating suites must supply dedicated 120V/15A electrical outlets and ensure an unobstructed clearance of at least 1.5 meters around each scrubber intake vent.

Application Deadline: Requests must be submitted through the tenant service portal no later than September 29. Pre-installation inspections will be conducted by building technicians between October 1 and October 3.

Priority 1 (Optical calibration and lens testing lab)

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論題常將表格中的代碼或分類（如 Priority 1）與說明文件中的定義相結合，以確認事實屬性。

questions.prompt: What does Veloce Optics Design's security deposit cover?

options.label: A

options.label: B

explanation.summary_zh: 這筆押金對應的是標準免費配額之外的一台補充設備。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一篇規定每間承租單位最多可免費取得兩台清淨機；第二篇表格顯示 Veloce Optics 申請三台。三台減去兩台免費配額，剩下一台補充設備，因此選 B。第一篇另規定每台補充設備需支付 140 美元可退還押金，與第二篇記錄已收取的 140 美元相符。這裡的押金是依補充設備數量收取，不是對全部三台設備逐台收費。

option_analysis.label: A

option_analysis.label: B

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。三台是第二篇記錄的全部申請量，不是免費配額之外的數量。第一篇提供兩台免費配額，所以只有一台需要押金。

option_analysis.label: D

evidence.quote: Standard allocations include up to two portable scrubbers per leased suite at no cost.
Each supplemental scrubber requires a refundable security deposit of $140
3 units
Approved: Deposit of $140 collected

content.title: Alderwood Architectural Group Office Relocation Notice, Schedule, and Follow-up Email
content.scenario_summary: Alderwood Architectural Group is relocating from Old Mill Chambers to Mercer Plaza. A company notice defines packaging protocols and tagging categories for confidential archives and equipment. A phased moving schedule details department windows, destination suites, freight elevator assignments, and dock requirements. An archivist supervisor emails the relocation coordinator to request missing red labels for historical blueprints and confirm dock access for their department's wide-format equipment.

blocks.text: Alderwood Architectural Group: Corporate Relocation Protocols

Between November 14 and 17, Alderwood Architectural Group will relocate from Old Mill Chambers to Mercer Plaza. Staff must follow packing and tagging requirements for their department's transit window.

Moving crates have been placed in department corridors. Office supplies, catalogs, and general project folders must carry yellow tags. IT hardware—including desktop PCs, dual displays, and render nodes—must be powered down by 5:00 P.M. the evening before departure and marked with purple tags. Red tags are strictly reserved for confidential client contracts and original architectural blueprints, which must be secured in lockable plastic crates rather than standard cardboard boxes.

Any department moving oversized equipment, such as wide-format plotters or scale models, must submit a Heavy Equipment Transport Manifest to Facilities at least 48 hours before transit. Crates lacking room numbers or workstation identifiers will be routed to the ground-floor staging area at Old Mill Chambers for manual inventory. Direct general inquiries to Relocation Director Warren Pike.
Mercer Plaza Phased Move & Elevator Allocation (November 14–17)

Phase 1 (Nov 14): Interior Design & Render Studio, Suite 400, Elevator B, Vanguard Transit. Phase 2 (Nov 15): Structural Engineering & Survey, Suite 520, Elevator A, Vanguard Transit. Phase 3 (Nov 16): Urban Planning & Heritage Archives, Suite 310, Elevator C, Apex Commercial. Phase 4 (Nov 17): Executive Operations & Accounts, Suite 600, Elevator A, Apex Commercial.

Special Notice: Freight Elevator C features extended ceiling clearance (3.2 meters) and is reserved for wide-format drafting equipment and flat-file storage units. Shipments using Elevator C must be unloaded at Dock Bay 4. Contact Dock Supervisor Brenda Castillo for bay access.
To: Warren Pike <wpike@alderwoodarch.example>
From: Dennis Cho <dcho@alderwoodarch.example>
Date: November 15
Subject: Packing update and equipment manifest

Hi Warren, following yesterday's briefing, our Urban Planning & Heritage Archives team has nearly completed packing for tomorrow's scheduled departure. Our staff members have boxed general research references with yellow tags and safely disconnected our rendering workstations.

However, we encountered a label shortage while packing original architectural blueprints and historic client agreements. We placed these documents in lockable plastic crates as instructed, but were six labels short. Could Facilities deliver six additional tags of the required category to Room 204 before 4:30 P.M. today?

Additionally, our wide-format archival scanner and blueprint plotter cannot be disassembled until 8:00 A.M. tomorrow because we must produce urgent drawings requested by municipal planners this morning. I have attached our Heavy Equipment Transport Manifest for your records. Please coordinate with Brenda Castillo so the movers can access the proper dock bay upon arrival.
Best regards, Dennis Cho, Heritage Planning Supervisor

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the notice?

options.label: A
options.text: To outline packing, labeling, and equipment transfer rules for an upcoming corporate move

options.label: B
options.text: To inform employees about safety inspections conducted by Mercer Plaza management

options.label: C
options.text: To collect department staff preferences regarding new workstation layouts

options.label: D
options.text: To explain schedule revisions caused by freight elevator maintenance

explanation.summary_zh: 公告的主要目的是為即將展開的企業辦公室搬遷說明打包、標籤標示及設備運送規範。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一篇公告首段說明公司將於 11 月 14 至 17 日搬遷，並要求員工遵守各部門搬遷時段的打包與標籤規範（Staff must follow packing and tagging requirements for their department's transit window.）。接續段落進一步規定標籤顏色、資訊硬體斷電時間、機密合約與原始藍圖的專用容器，以及大型設備申報流程。因此 (A) 最精確地概括公告目的。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。全文重點在於說明各類物品標籤規範、設備斷電時間、機密檔案專用容器以及大型設備申報流程。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。公告中並未提及新大樓管理處進行安全檢查（safety inspections）。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文中並未向員工收集任何關於新辦公室工位配置的偏好（workstation layouts）。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。搬遷時程是既定安排，公告中並未提及因貨梯維修而造成時程修訂（schedule revisions）。

evidence.quote: Staff must follow packing and tagging requirements for their department's transit window.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解答主旨題時，先辨識公告要求讀者採取的主要行動，再確認選項能涵蓋後續規範的整體範圍，而非只抓單一細節。

questions.prompt: According to the notice, what must staff members do with computing hardware before departure?

options.label: A
options.text: Store it in lockable plastic containers on the ground floor

options.label: B
options.text: Shut it down by 5:00 P.M. on the day prior to transit

options.label: C
options.text: Submit a special transport manifest to Facilities

options.label: D
options.text: Request an inspection from Vanguard Transit

explanation.summary_zh: 根據公告規定，員工必須在出發前一天的下午五點前將電腦硬體關機。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 公告第二段明確規定：「IT hardware—including desktop PCs, dual displays, and render nodes—must be powered down by 5:00 P.M. the evening before departure and marked with purple tags.」（資訊硬體——包括桌上型電腦、雙螢幕及算圖節點——必須在出發前一晚下午五點前關機，並貼上紫色標籤）。選項 (B) 的「Shut it down by 5:00 P.M. on the day prior to transit」精準改寫了「powered down by 5:00 P.M. the evening before departure」，因此為正確答案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。上鎖塑膠箱是用於收納機密合約與原始藍圖，而非電腦硬體。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。符合原文中「powered down by 5:00 P.M. the evening before departure」的同義轉換。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。申報表（Heavy Equipment Transport Manifest）是針對大型設備（如繪圖機或模型），而非一般電腦硬體。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。公告未要求搬家公司在搬遷前檢查電腦設備。

evidence.quote: IT hardware—including desktop PCs, dual displays, and render nodes—must be powered down by 5:00 P.M. the evening before departure and marked with purple tags.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題常藉由同義詞轉換呈現答案，如將「power down」替換為「shut down」，「the evening before departure」替換為「the day prior to transit」。

questions.prompt: What is suggested about Freight Elevator C at Mercer Plaza?

options.label: A
options.text: It is reserved exclusively for executive staff during Phase 4.

options.label: B
options.text: It has dimensions capable of carrying items too tall for standard freight lifts.

options.label: C
options.text: It connects directly to all loading dock bays in the building.

options.label: D
options.text: It requires maintenance before it can be used on November 16.

explanation.summary_zh: 時程表附註暗示貨梯 C 具有能夠容納一般標準貨梯無法承載之高大物品的空間尺寸。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第二篇時程表下方的特別附註指出：「Freight Elevator C features extended ceiling clearance (3.2 meters) and is reserved for wide-format drafting equipment and flat-file storage units.」（貨梯 C 具備挑高淨空［3.2 公尺］，專供寬幅製圖設備與扁平收納櫃使用）。文中特別提及「extended ceiling clearance」以及專供大尺寸設備使用，合理推知該貨梯的空間規格能夠容納其他一般貨梯無法搬運的挑高物件，故 (B) 為正解。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。第四階段（Phase 4）的高階主管與會計部門使用的是貨梯 A（Elevator A），而非貨梯 C。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。附註強調貨梯 C 具備 3.2 公尺的加大淨空高度，專供超大規格設備，暗示其能承載標準貨梯裝不下的高大物品。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文中只指定使用貨梯 C 的貨件應在 Dock Bay 4 卸載，未說明該貨梯與其他卸貨門的實體連通情形，因此不能推得它直通所有卸貨門。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文中並未提及貨梯 C 需要維修或無法正常運作。

evidence.quote: Special Notice: Freight Elevator C features extended ceiling clearance (3.2 meters) and is reserved for wide-format drafting equipment and flat-file storage units.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 本題可由 extended ceiling clearance（加大淨空高度）與專用設備安排，推知貨梯 C 適合較高的貨件；但不能自行補入其他貨梯的確切尺寸或卸貨門連通配置。

questions.prompt: Which loading dock bay should be used when unloading items for Mr. Cho's department at Mercer Plaza?

explanation.summary_zh: 為 Cho 先生的部門卸載物品時，應使用 4 號卸貨門（Dock Bay 4）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 此題需要串聯第二篇與第三篇的資訊。在第三篇電郵中，Dennis Cho 的職稱為「Heritage Planning Supervisor」，並在內文提及「our Urban Planning & Heritage Archives team」（我們的都市規劃與文化資產檔案團隊）。對照第二篇時程表，該部門排定於 Phase 3（11 月 16 日）搬遷，分配使用的貨梯為「Elevator C」。接著查閱第二篇時程表下方的特別附註：「Shipments using Elevator C must be unloaded at Dock Bay 4.」（使用貨梯 C 的運輸貨件必須在 4 號卸貨門卸載）。綜合這兩篇資訊，可知 Cho 先生部門的貨品必須在 Dock Bay 4 卸貨，故選 (D)。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文中未提及 Dock Bay 1。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文中未提及 Dock Bay 2。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。易因該部門隸屬第三階段（Phase 3）而誤選 Dock Bay 3，但文中並無此碼頭之規定。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。第三篇顯示 Cho 先生代表 Urban Planning & Heritage Archives；第二篇表格顯示該部門使用 Elevator C，而附註規定使用 Elevator C 之貨件必須於 Dock Bay 4 卸載。

evidence.quote: Hi Warren, following yesterday's briefing, our Urban Planning & Heritage Archives team has nearly completed packing for tomorrow's scheduled departure.
Phase 3 (Nov 16): Urban Planning & Heritage Archives, Suite 310, Elevator C, Apex Commercial.
Shipments using Elevator C must be unloaded at Dock Bay 4.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件題目常需順著「人物身分 → 表格對應資源（如特定電梯） → 附註規定之實體地點（如特定卸貨門）」的邏輯鏈條逐步解題。

questions.prompt: What color tags should Facilities deliver to Mr. Cho's team?

explanation.summary_zh: 總務設施部應發送給 Cho 先生團隊的標籤顏色為紅色（Red）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本題需結合第一篇與第三篇。第三篇說明團隊在打包原始建築藍圖與歷史客戶合約時缺少六張標籤，並要求補發所需類別的標籤。第一篇規定原始建築藍圖與機密客戶合約使用紅色標籤；其中「原始建築藍圖」已明確對應紅色類別，足以判定應選 (C)，無須假定所有歷史合約都屬機密。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。第一篇指出黃色標籤用於一般文具、目錄與普通專案資料夾。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。第一篇指出紫色標籤用於資訊硬體設備（如電腦主機與螢幕）。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。第三篇指出缺少標籤的物品包括原始建築藍圖；第一篇明確規定原始建築藍圖使用紅色標籤，因此應補發紅色標籤。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。第一篇公告的標籤分類系統中並未出現藍色標籤。

evidence.quote: However, we encountered a label shortage while packing original architectural blueprints and historic client agreements.
Red tags are strictly reserved for confidential client contracts and original architectural blueprints, which must be secured in lockable plastic crates rather than standard cardboard boxes.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 當後續信件提及某項物品短缺卻未明說顏色或規格時，應以信中描述的物品屬性為線索，返回前文的分類規範指南中尋找對應的代號或顏色。

content.title: Kensington Court Suites Guest Preference Initiative
content.scenario_summary: A hospitality trade article reports on Kensington Court Suites introducing a tailored workspace and pantry customization service for extended-stay guests. A business traveler emails guest services after encountering portal maintenance to request specific office peripherals and beverage items for her upcoming reservation. An internal service fulfillment notice confirms the completion of her suite preparation according to brand policies.

blocks.text: Tailoring the Extended Stay: Kensington Court Suites Unveils Custom Workspace Program

MANCHESTER — Kensington Court Suites has introduced its Custom Workspace Initiative, an amenity program tailored for corporate travelers booking stays of five nights or longer. Recognizing that extended-stay guests require more than a generic desk, the property now allows guests to personalize their room prior to arrival. Available inventory includes ergonomic peripherals such as ultrawide displays, vertical mice, and adjustable standing desk converters, as well as customized pantry provisions like regional dairy alternatives and artisan coffees.

To participate, guests must submit their preferences through the hotel portal at least 72 hours before arrival. Standard suite bookings include up to two complimentary peripherals, whereas guests in Executive Club Suites enjoy an unlimited peripheral package and guaranteed room readiness before 2:00 P.M. on check-in day. In addition, guests selecting whole-bean coffee blends are automatically supplied with a manual burr grinder to ensure beverage freshness. 'Our goal is to make business travel seamless while avoiding the waste of unneeded amenities,' explained Guest Experience Director Liam Mercer.
To: Guest Services <guestservices@kensingtoncourt.example>
From: Dr. Miriam Vance <m.vance@vancestrategies.example>
Date: October 18
Subject: Workspace Preferences - Reservation #KC-84192

Dear Guest Services Team, I will be arriving this Thursday, October 24, for an eight-night stay in an Executive Club Suite (Reservation #KC-84192). I attempted to finalize my setup preferences through the online portal yesterday, but the peripheral selection menu was temporarily unavailable due to site maintenance.

Could your team please arrange the following workspace equipment for Suite 504: an ultrawide monitor, an adjustable standing converter, and an ergonomic vertical mouse? For the beverage pantry, I would appreciate unsweetened almond milk and whole-bean decaf coffee. Because my flight lands in Manchester late morning, having the room ready by 1:30 P.M. would be ideal if possible. Thank you for your assistance, Dr. Miriam Vance.
Kensington Court Suites — Service Fulfillment Notice
Guest: Dr. Miriam Vance | Room: Suite 504 | Arrival: October 24
Facilities and Housekeeping teams must complete preparation for this arrival by 1:00 P.M. on October 24.
Summary of Equipment and Pantry Fulfillment
rows: Ultrawide Monitor (Asset #M-104), Standing Converter (Asset #SC-22), Vertical Mouse (Asset #VM-08)
Unsweetened Almond Milk (1L carafe), Artisan Decaf Beans (250g), Manual Burr Grinder (Unit #BG-12)

blocks.text: Inspection Sign-off: Setup verified complete at 12:45 P.M. Room keycards transferred to Front Desk for arrival.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: To announce a hotel's new customized amenity program for extended stays

options.label: B
options.text: To review guest feedback on recently upgraded conference facilities

options.label: C
options.text: To compare the corporate rates of various lodging chains in Manchester

options.label: D
options.text: To outline safety regulations for operating office equipment in guest rooms

explanation.summary_zh: 該報導旨在宣布一家飯店針對長期住宿房客推出的客製化備品服務方案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第一篇文章開篇即說明 Kensington Court Suites 推出了「Custom Workspace Initiative」，這是一項專門為預訂五晚以上商務旅客打造的個人化工作區與茶水點心自選服務。文章接續詳述了申請資格、提供品項以及高階套房專屬權益，因此核心主旨是介紹並宣布該項新服務方案。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。文章明確報導該飯店針對五晚以上的長期商務客推出了可預先客製辦公周邊與食品飲品的新服務（Custom Workspace Initiative）。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文中並未提及會議設施（conference facilities）的改建，亦未回顧或分析旅客評價。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文章只報導 Kensington Court Suites 一家飯店的新措施，並未橫向比較曼徹斯特各連鎖飯店的企業簽約價格（corporate rates）。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文中雖然列出多項辦公周邊設備，但重點在於提供客製化配置，完全沒有提及任何設備操作的安全規範（safety regulations）。

evidence.quote: Kensington Court Suites has introduced its Custom Workspace Initiative, an amenity program tailored for corporate travelers booking stays of five nights or longer.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 解答長篇報導的主旨題時，應抓住首段的主題句（如新方案發表與適用對象），避免被文中出現的次要細節（如設備名稱、飯店地點）干擾而選擇過窄或無中生有的選項。

questions.prompt: According to the article, what is NOT mentioned as a condition or feature of the Custom Workspace Initiative?

options.label: A
options.text: A minimum reservation length of five nights

options.label: C
options.text: A requirement to submit an employment verification letter

options.label: D
options.text: A two-item limit on complimentary peripherals for standard suites

explanation.summary_zh: 文章中完全未提及需要繳交在職證明文件。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文章第一段提到適用對象為預訂五晚以上的商務旅客（A 選項符合）；第二段提到必須在抵達前至少 72 小時透過線上系統送出需求（B 選項符合），且標準套房免費提供至多兩件周邊設備（D 選項符合）。文中完全沒有提及房客需要提交在職證明書（employment verification letter），故選 C。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤（文章有提及）。第一段載明「tailored for corporate travelers booking stays of five nights or longer」，確實有五晚的最低天數限制。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤（文章有提及）。第二段載明「must submit their preferences through the hotel portal at least 72 hours before arrival」，確實有 72 小時前提出的規定。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確（文章未提及）。文章未規定房客必須提供在職證明或公司雇傭相關證明文件。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤（文章有提及）。第二段載明「Standard suite bookings include up to two complimentary peripherals」，確實有兩件免費配額的上限。

evidence.quote: tailored for corporate travelers booking stays of five nights or longer.
To participate, guests must submit their preferences through the hotel portal at least 72 hours before arrival. Standard suite bookings include up to two complimentary peripherals

explanation.takeaway_zh: 面對否定細節題（NOT mentioned），應將四個選項逐一回到原文中比對定位，已明確出現的具體規定予以排除，未提及或憑空捏造的門檻即為正解。

questions.prompt: What does Dr. Vance indicate in her email?

options.label: A
options.text: She will be unable to arrive in Manchester before 2:00 P.M.

options.label: B
options.text: She contacted guest services directly because an online tool was offline.

options.label: C
options.text: She would like to upgrade her reservation to an Executive Club Suite.

options.label: D
options.text: She requires technical support to connect her laptop to the monitor.

explanation.summary_zh: Vance 博士在信中表示，她是因線上預選系統維護無法使用，才改以電子郵件直接聯絡客服。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 在第二篇文章第一段中，Vance 博士說明她昨天曾嘗試透過線上門戶（online portal）完成配置偏好，但周邊設備選單因網站維護暫時無法使用（temporarily unavailable due to site maintenance）。因此她改由發信向客服人員提出具體品項需求，這正是選項 B 的合理推論與改寫。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。信中提到她的班機於接近中午時降落，並希望房間能在 1:30 P.M. 準備好，顯示她會在 2:00 P.M. 之前抵達。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。信中指出周邊設備選單因網站維護而暫時無法使用，因此她改以電子郵件向客服提出配置需求；文中未說明電子郵件是唯一可用的聯絡方式。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。信件第一段指出她原本預訂的就是「Executive Club Suite」，並非提出房型升等請求。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。她只是向客服列出希望擺放的設備清單，並未要求飯店派技術人員協助筆電連接。

evidence.quote: I attempted to finalize my setup preferences through the online portal yesterday, but the peripheral selection menu was temporarily unavailable due to site maintenance.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論題常將信件中提到的突發狀況（如系統維護、外部限制）與發信動機結合進行同義改寫（site maintenance unavailable 改寫為 online tool was offline）。

questions.prompt: Compared with Dr. Vance's preferred room-readiness time, when was the setup of Suite 504 verified complete?

explanation.summary_zh: Suite 504 的配置於下午 12:45 確認完成，比 Vance 博士希望的下午 1:30 提早 45 分鐘。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第二篇電郵中，Vance 博士表示希望房間能在下午 1:30 準備好；第三篇服務單的驗收紀錄則寫明配置已於下午 12:45 確認完成。從 12:45 到 1:30 相差 45 分鐘，因此選 A。第三篇的下午 1:00 是內部準備期限，第一篇的下午 2:00 是行政俱樂部套房準備保證所列的時間界線，均不是本題要比較的旅客偏好時間。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。電郵中的偏好時間為下午 1:30，服務單記錄的確認完成時間為下午 12:45，前後相差 45 分鐘。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。15 分鐘是下午 12:45 與下午 1:00 內部期限的差距；本題問的是與旅客希望的下午 1:30 相比。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。30 分鐘是下午 1:00 內部期限與下午 1:30 旅客偏好時間的差距；配置確認完成時間實際記錄為下午 12:45。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。75 分鐘是下午 12:45 與下午 2:00 的差距；下午 2:00 是行政俱樂部套房一般準備保證的時間界線，並非 Vance 博士提出的下午 1:30。

evidence.quote: Because my flight lands in Manchester late morning, having the room ready by 1:30 P.M. would be ideal if possible.
Inspection Sign-off: Setup verified complete at 12:45 P.M. Room keycards transferred to Front Desk for arrival.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件比較時間時，先辨認題目指定的兩種時間：本題是旅客在電郵中提出的偏好時間，以及服務單記錄的確認完成時間。不要將內部工作期限或一般服務保證的時間界線混入計算。

questions.prompt: Why was Unit #BG-12 placed in Suite 504?

options.label: A
options.text: Dr. Vance specifically requested that model in her email.

options.label: B
options.text: It is provided routinely whenever whole-bean coffee is chosen.

options.label: C
options.text: The hotel had run out of pre-ground decaf coffee packages.

options.label: D
options.text: Executive Club Suites come standard with kitchen cooking appliances.

explanation.summary_zh: 飯店政策規定只要房客選擇整粒咖啡豆，就會自動附上手動磨豆機，而 Vance 博士剛好選擇了低因咖啡豆。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 第三篇服務單的表格將 Unit #BG-12 標示為「Manual Burr Grinder」（手動磨豆機），同一列也列出低因咖啡豆。第一篇報導說明，選擇整粒咖啡豆的房客會自動獲配手動磨豆機。結合這兩篇即可辨識設備並確認其配發原因，因此選 B。第二篇電郵另可佐證 Vance 博士選了 whole-bean decaf coffee，而且沒有指定磨豆機型號；它提供額外確認，但並非得出此答案不可缺少的第三份資訊。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。第二篇信件顯示 Vance 博士僅註明需要低因原豆與無糖杏仁奶，並未指定磨豆機或特定設備型號。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。第一篇載明選擇整粒咖啡豆的房客會自動獲配手動磨豆機，第三篇確認 Unit #BG-12 即為該磨豆機。第二篇的咖啡豆需求亦與此政策相符；文件未說明這是另行購買的項目。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文件中沒有任何跡象顯示研磨咖啡粉缺貨，配發磨豆機完全是因為房客主動選擇原豆。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 錯誤。文件未載明行政俱樂部套房固定提供烹飪廚電的政策。第一篇明確說明的是選擇整粒咖啡豆後自動配發磨豆機，因此本題的配發原因是咖啡選項，而不是套房類別。

evidence.quote: In addition, guests selecting whole-bean coffee blends are automatically supplied with a manual burr grinder to ensure beverage freshness.
For the beverage pantry, I would appreciate unsweetened almond milk and whole-bean decaf coffee.
Unsweetened Almond Milk (1L carafe), Artisan Decaf Beans (250g), Manual Burr Grinder (Unit #BG-12)

explanation.takeaway_zh: 高難度的多篇閱讀題常要求考生辨識「未在需求信中明講，卻出現在執行清單上的物品」。解題關鍵在於查閱第一篇的相關政策條款，找出該品項是基於何種前置選項（如選擇咖啡原豆）而觸發的自動配送。
